# Modal

A dialog that blocks the page until it is answered or closed.

```tsx
import { Modal } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- For a task or decision that needs the reader's full attention.

## When not to

- For information the reader can ignore: use Alert or Popover.
- For marketing prompts on page load.

## Examples

### Form in a dialog

The page behind is inert, Tab stays inside, Esc closes, and focus returns to the button that opened it.

```tsx
<Demo />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` (required) | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onOpenChange` (required) | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called with `false` when the dialog is closed by Esc, the close button or a click on the backdrop. |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The dialog's name, shown as its heading. Required: a dialog without a name is announced as just "dialog". |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | Short text under the title, read as the dialog's description. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Buttons at the bottom. Put the main action last. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |  |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether a click on the backdrop closes the dialog. Turn it off when closing would lose work. |
| `role` | `'dialog' \| 'alertdialog'` |  | `alertdialog` interrupts with a message that needs an answer (ConfirmDialog uses it when the action destroys something). |
| `side` | `'center' \| 'start' \| 'end' \| 'bottom'` | `'center'` | Used by Drawer. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- **Built on the native `<dialog>`:** the page behind is inert, focus stays inside, Esc closes.
- It is labelled by its title and described by its description; focus starts on the first control and returns to the opener on close.
- The page doesn't scroll while it's open. Motion is removed under reduced motion.
- The close button is 44 px.

## Content

- Title says what the dialog is for. Primary action on the right.
